Choose two lattice points on the line, for example \((-4,0)\) and \((0,2)\).

The rise is \(2-0=2\), and the run is \(0-(-4)=4\). Thus
\[
\text{slope}=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}=\frac{2}{4}=\frac12.
\]
